source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The second-window scenario explicitly closes the window and clears its window/promise locals before assertNoDetachedWindows. The helper minimizes memory, gathers top-window report paths and reports any path containing detached. A source assertion for that scenario does not prove every window reference is absent or establish a passing leak test. The scoped arbitrary-delay exception remains test uncertainty, not a general waiting rule.
title: Detached-window assertions inspect reported windows after closing and releasing test references
